outputs.prompt: Use the attached neutral gray rocky-cliff Shiren game screenshot (鈴なり峠, earthy room and green verge) as DESIGN reference for form, scale and subdued color only. The beige/white column-fence game screenshots are FAILURE examples to avoid. Do not copy any reference artwork. Create ORIGINAL painterly fantasy roguelike continuous material atlas, square image exact 2x2 equal cells opaque with no borders or text. Palette unified desaturated neutral/slightly blue-purple gray stone: midtone #62646a, recesses #363b43, restrained edge highlights #8a8d87, sparse deep olive green moss #506341. No cream or white stone, no gold, no red volcanic glow. TOP LEFT: subdued vertically faceted broken angular rock SIDE material, coherent rugged cliff faces, small and medium uneven pieces, not cylindrical pillars, no flat saw-cut tops, no horizontal brick courses. TOP RIGHT: matching dense irregular angular rock crowns seen from steep elevated camera, medium-scale jagged uneven stone shapes overlapping naturally, varied heights, top and side facets share same material/light, NOT flat paving, NOT huge smooth boulders, NOT a slab. BOTTOM LEFT: matching darker interior cliff mass, same rock size and palette, irregular faceted rocks with recesses. BOTTOM RIGHT: matching narrow rock crest material, irregular pointed/chipped angular crowns, same subdued color and size. All quadrants are raw seamless opaque materials filling edges, no ground patches or empty silhouettes, no black void or tile grid. Root detail very sparse, dark and thin, NOT thick ropes wrapped around every stone. A single soft daylight from upper left. Clear broad painterly forms with modest fine detail, like a coherent sculpted game environment, no noisy photoreal stone grain.

Use the attached neutral dark-gray rocky-cliff Shiren screenshot (鈴なり峠) as DESIGN reference for irregular rock shapes and subdued palette only, not the red volcano. The beige white repeating pillar-fence screenshots are FAILURE examples. Create ORIGINAL transparent environment sprites for a fantasy roguelike wall boundary, square image exact 2x2 equal cells; each cell ONE DIFFERENT compact continuous cluster of 3-5 jagged angular rocks, all four facing camera bottom from a steep 65-degree overhead view. Object top surfaces and vertical sides must be one coherent sculpted volume. Gray stone midtone #62646a recess #363b43 highlights #8a8d87; muted deep olive moss #506341 only in crevices, tiny dark root tendrils, no thick root ropes. NO white or beige columns, NO cylinders, NO cut-flat tops, NO masonry bricks, NO fence rhythm. Broad angular uneven crags of mixed height, some slanted pointed or chipped, lower pieces around one taller piece, asymmetrical and naturally interlocked, not separate tall stalagmites. Top-left cluster broad and squat, top-right cluster one tilted taller crag and low rocks, bottom-left irregular chipped ridge, bottom-right mixed compact crags. Consistent scale and palette across cells. True alpha-zero background AND gaps, solid opaque rocks with only thin antialiased edge pixels. No floor, no backing rectangle, no plinth, no halo. Each cluster has at least 12% transparent padding on every side, fully inside its cell, absolutely no stray pixels near cell borders. Rich but restrained painterly 2.5D original game art, same soft upper-left light, no photoreal grit. These sprites will be repeated with small changes of scale, so avoid a highly distinctive tree root or central landmark motif.
